dash.title: Is the device working?
dash.intro: This page asks each part of OpenVoiceOS if it is running.
dash.down.title: If something is down
dash.noanswer: This service did not answer. It is probably not running.
dash.down.lead: Otherwise, here is what usually helps.
dash.down.busmon: Watch the messages on the bus with
dash.down.busmon.tail: , if it runs on this device.
dash.down.settings.tail: page. Every save keeps a backup, so you can go back.
dash.down.tech.summary: For people comfortable with a terminal
dash.down.tech.log: Read the log of the service:
dash.sum.busdown.sub: The message bus is down, so nothing else can answer. See what to do below.
service.media.caveat: No answer is normal if this device has no ovos-media installed.
service.voice.caveat: No answer here is normal if this device uses ovos-simple-listener, which does not report status.
service.gui_service.caveat: No answer is normal if this device has no screen.
service.PHAL.caveat: No answer is normal if this device has no extra hardware plugins.
dash.down.tech.norestart: This page does not restart services itself: the panel controls the device over the message bus, which cannot help while the bus is down. See the security notes.
dash.down.ask: If you are not sure what to do, ask whoever set up your device.
dash.token.notice: This device has no access token yet — set one to enable installing, speaking, and device controls.
